title: TabletopGames
description: A brief dataset on tabletop board games. It includes the names of the games, the release date, main genre etc.

items.title: Tabletop game
items.description: A single tabletop game, with its genre, designers, expansions, etc.

game_id.title: Game ID
game_id.description: Sequentially assigned integers describing one tabletop game starting from 1 (one)

game_name.title: Game name
game_name.description: Title of the board game used at the time of initial publishing

release_year.title: Release year
release_year.description: Original year of release of the board game

min_players.title: Minimum players
min_players.description: Minimum amount of players needed to play the game

max_players.title: Maximum players
max_players.description: Maximum amount of players allowed to play the game (if value is NULL then there is no maximum limit)

recommended_min_age.title: Recommended minimum age
recommended_min_age.description: Minimum age recommended to play this game

playtime_minutes.title: Playtime in minutes
playtime_minutes.description: Minimum estimated time to play one session

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: The main publisher responsible for publishing the original game (only the original publisher is listed)

avg_rating.title: Average rating
avg_rating.description: Average rating taken across multiple rating websites

genre_id.title: Genre ID
genre_id.description: Sequentially assigned integers describing genres starting from 1 (one)

genre_name.title: Genre name
genre_name.description: Arbitrarily chosen most fitting genre of the tabletop game

expansions.title: Expansions
expansions.description: Array containing multiple (or none) expansions that are released for a game (NULL if the game has no expansions)

items.title: Expansion
items.description: One expansion of a tabletop game

expansion_id.title: Expansion ID
expansion_id.description: Sequentially assigned integers describing an expansion starting from 1 (one)

expansion_name.title: Expansion name
expansion_name.description: Name of the tabletop game expansion

expansion_release_year.title: Expansion release year
expansion_release_year.description: Year of release of the tabletop game expansion

designers.title: Designers
designers.description: Array containing one or more designers that are credited for the original tabletop game (does not include expansions)

items.title: Designer
items.description: One designer of a tabletop game

designer_id.title: Designer ID
designer_id.description: Sequentially assigned integers describing a designer starting from 1 (one)
